playbooks.description: Given a controller is absent from current inventory, when the operator opens its details, then the unavailable state and recovery explanation are shown.
Given OpenRGB is disabled, when the operator opens Overview, then the saved Off policy and empty controller state are explicit.

Given the complete phone Customize editor in an isolated browser and routed storage lease, when physical bands, browser preview preference, freshness, fallback and Load thresholds are saved as drafts, then each draft restores independently without selecting a policy.

Given a 390 by 844 phone viewport and a synthetic 34px safe area, when Presets loads and scrolls to guardrails, then Save draft, Save and use, and manual Off stay fully above navigation with 44px hit targets.
Given the saved policy is available, when the operator opens Presets, then the selected preset editor and separate draft/use actions are visible.
Given the optional backend remains disabled, when the operator opens Settings, then backend status, setup guidance, and saved policy controls are visible.
